purpose: Improve actual story continuation after the user-reported failures; preserve all earlier experiments as historical evidence.
training_groups: unchanged seed-17 normalized-group split rule, train bucket only, across the bounded expanded prefix
development: first 200 group IDs in sorted order assigned development by the existing split rule, excluding every group from the original 8 MiB prefix
fresh_final: first 200 group IDs in sorted order assigned final by the existing split rule, excluding every group from the original 8 MiB prefix; never encode or score until a single deployment candidate is frozen
old_final: already used; do not rescore or use for new selection
initialization: new random initialization, not pretrained fine-tuning; new vocabulary/position tables prevent a drop-in old checkpoint resume
selection: minimum fixed-development mean NLL among recorded 1000-update checkpoints; final set cannot influence selection
diagnostic_prompts: Once upon a time tere was a fox and it was blue but
Once upon a time there was a fox and it was blue, but
Mia found a small red box.
Tom wanted to help his friend.
The little bird was afraid of the rain.
Sara could not find her toy.
One morning, a rabbit saw a bright light.
quality_decision: Inspect all paired retained continuations; report malformed words, grammar, prompt/character continuity and story completion. Assistant review must be identified; human review stays pending. Only label output improved when observations support it; no guaranteed perfect quality.
cross_tokenizer_comparison: Raw NLL/perplexity units differ. Use total negative log likelihood including EOS divided by UTF-8 content bytes (bits/byte) on identical story text; report differing context/segmentation as confounds. Compare same visible word budget qualitatively as well as fixed-ID budget.
implementation_policy: Keep explicit existing attention/blocks. Resource pilot may adjust microbatch/accumulation to preserve 32 effective rows before main training; any schedule/data/model amendment must be recorded before fresh-final access.
promotion: Freeze selected inference bytes/tokenizer/config before fresh-final scoring, record old/new sample review, then update application defaults and portable release with rollback to historical model. Preserve original artifacts/notes.
